sentences: This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to.
We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.

We also have a wedding season which is coming, while rural will come into some question with the monsoon deficit of what is really, we are talking of, but we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
We seem to be quite happy of what we had predicted last quarter, that we should be in that band of about 8% to 10%.
At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.
We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.
Possibly it would be in the range of about 8-9%.

sentences: And we basically believe that going forward, we are still looking atleast a high single-digit volume growth in terms of what we would kind of achieve.

So, while there could be a little bit of upstocking, which could happen because of the price increases, we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.
And we feel that over a period of time, it is good to maintain that 3-4% gap, which would remain from a point of view of overall direction between volume and value.
But, we think that this trajectory of 3-4% will remain as we go ahead.

bull: Strong revenue growth in recent quarters (+17.9% in Q1 FY27, +16.9% in Q2 FY27).
H1 FY27 PAT grew +23.8% YoY to 2,644 crore alongside 18.2% EBITDA margin.
Cash from operations expanded significantly to 7,088 crore in FY26.
bear: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin dropped sharply to 15.6% from 20.6% in Q1 FY27.
Borrowings increased to 3,929 crore at FY26-end up from 2,290 crore in FY25.
Sequential revenue declined -5.4% in Q2 FY27 compared to Q1 FY27.
